```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This report is to compare the custom clusterings to the original merged
clustering.

#### Load libraries, source code 

```{r seed, message = FALSE}
set.seed(37)
```

```{r source, message = FALSE}
source(file =  snakemake@params[["plotting"]])
source(file = snakemake@params[["custom_utils"]])
```

```{r colors, message = FALSE}
colors_path <- snakemake@params[["colors_path"]]
source(snakemake@params[["colors"]])

col_cts_hsc <- c(col_cts_hsc, "removed" = "grey70")
col_cts_hsc_orig <- col_cts_hsc
names(col_cts_hsc_orig) <- paste0("orig ", names(col_cts_hsc_orig))
col_cts_hsc_orig
```

```{r libraries, message = FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment, quietly = TRUE)
library(tidyverse, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggalluvial, quietly = TRUE)
```

```{r load_objects}
sce_mmus_hsc <- readRDS("/omics/odcf/analysis/OE0538_projects/DO-0008/data/scRNAseq/main_analysis/sce_objects/02_sce_anno/02_clst/custom/sce_mmus_hsc_custom.rds")
sce_mcas_hsc <- readRDS("/omics/odcf/analysis/OE0538_projects/DO-0008/data/scRNAseq/main_analysis/sce_objects/02_sce_anno/02_clst/custom/sce_mcas_hsc_custom.rds")
sce_mspr_hsc <- readRDS("/omics/odcf/analysis/OE0538_projects/DO-0008/data/scRNAseq/main_analysis/sce_objects/02_sce_anno/02_clst/custom/sce_mspr_hsc_custom.rds")
sce_mcar_hsc <- readRDS("/omics/odcf/analysis/OE0538_projects/DO-0008/data/scRNAseq/main_analysis/sce_objects/02_sce_anno/02_clst/custom/sce_mcar_hsc_custom.rds")
```

```{r load_merged}
sce_hsc_all_cells <- readRDS("/omics/odcf/analysis/OE0538_projects/DO-0008/data/scRNAseq/main_analysis/sce_objects/02_sce_anno/02_clst/sce_hsc-02")

# remove unnecessary assays because the objects become too large to load
assays(sce_hsc_all_cells) <- list(
  counts = assays(sce_hsc_all_cells)$counts,
  logcounts = assays(sce_hsc_all_cells)$logcounts
)
reducedDims(sce_hsc_all_cells) <- list(
  UMAP = reducedDims(sce_hsc_all_cells)$UMAP
)
gc()
```

```{r cluster_labels}
# add all labels to the object that contains all cells

sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label <- vector(length = ncol(sce_hsc_all_cells))

# use unif here (some clusters with similar populations were unified)
sce_mmus_hsc$custom_label <- unfactor(sce_mmus_hsc$custom_label_unif)
sce_mcas_hsc$custom_label <- unfactor(sce_mcas_hsc$custom_label_unif)
sce_mspr_hsc$custom_label <- unfactor(sce_mspr_hsc$custom_label_unif)
sce_mcar_hsc$custom_label <- unfactor(sce_mcar_hsc$custom_label_unif)

sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label[match(
  colnames(sce_mmus_hsc), colnames(sce_hsc_all_cells))] <- sce_mmus_hsc$custom_label
sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label[match(
  colnames(sce_mcas_hsc), colnames(sce_hsc_all_cells))] <- sce_mcas_hsc$custom_label
sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label[match(
  colnames(sce_mspr_hsc), colnames(sce_hsc_all_cells))] <- sce_mspr_hsc$custom_label
sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label[match(
  colnames(sce_mcar_hsc), colnames(sce_hsc_all_cells))] <- sce_mcar_hsc$custom_label

rm(
  sce_mmus_hsc,
  sce_mcas_hsc,
  sce_mspr_hsc,
  sce_mcar_hsc)
gc()
```

```{r load_anno}
sce_hsc_anno <- readRDS("/omics/odcf/analysis/OE0538_projects/DO-0008/data_freeze/05_annotated_objects/sce_hsc.rds")

sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes <- vector(length = ncol(sce_hsc_all_cells))
sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes <- sce_hsc_anno$celltypes[
  match(colnames(sce_hsc_all_cells), colnames(sce_hsc_anno))]

rm(sce_hsc_anno)
gc()

# i have removed some cells from the finally annotated object, so those
# that are missing from that object are not called "removed"
levels(sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes) <- c(
  levels(sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes), 
  "removed")
sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes[is.na(sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes)] <- "removed"

# randomize the barcodes for nicer visualisation
sce_hsc_all_cells <- sce_hsc_all_cells[,base::sample(
  x = c(1:ncol(sce_hsc_all_cells)), 
  size = ncol(sce_hsc_all_cells),
  replace = FALSE)]
```

## Basics

```{r factor_and_colors}

unique(sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label)[!unique(sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label) %in% factors_custom_hsc_unif]
factors_custom_hsc_unif[!factors_custom_hsc_unif %in% sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label]

# for nicer handling factor the custom labels, too
# both from utils
sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label <- factor(
  sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label, 
  levels = factors_custom_hsc_unif)

col_custom <- col_custom_hsc_unif

stopifnot(!is.na(sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label))

#knitr::knit_exit()
print(col_custom)
```

```{r tables}
table(
  sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes,
  sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label)

table(
  sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes[sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID == "mmus"],
  sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label[sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID == "mmus"])

table(
  sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes[sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID == "mcas"],
  sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label[sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID == "mcas"])

table(
  sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes[sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID == "mspr"],
  sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label[sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID == "mspr"])

table(
  sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes[sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID == "mcar"],
  sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label[sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID == "mcar"])
```

## Comparison

### UMAPs

```{r umap_all_custom, fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
umap_base(sce_hsc_all_cells, "custom_label")+
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = col_custom)
```

```{r umap_all_orig, fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
umap_base(sce_hsc_all_cells, "celltypes")+
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = col_cts_hsc)
```

```{r umap_spec_custom, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 8}
umap_base(sce_hsc_all_cells, "custom_label")+
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = col_custom)+
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(facets = vars(sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID))
```

```{r umap_spec_orig, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 8}
umap_base(sce_hsc_all_cells, "celltypes")+
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = col_cts_hsc)+
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(facets = vars(sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID))
```

### Tiles

```{r mmus_tiles}
mat_mmus <- table(
  sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes[sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID == "mmus"],
  sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label[sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID == "mmus"])

for(i in 1:ncol(mat_mmus)){
  mat_mmus[,i] <- mat_mmus[,i]/base::sum(mat_mmus[,i])
}
mmus_df <- mat_mmus %>%
  base::as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.nan(Freq))

mmus_df$Var2 <- factor(
  mmus_df$Var2, 
  levels = rev(levels(sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label)[
    levels(sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label) %in% unique(unfactor(mmus_df$Var2))]))

ggplot2::ggplot(
  mmus_df, 
  aes(x = Var1, 
      y = Var2,
      fill = Freq))+
  ggplot2::geom_tile()+
  ggplot2::theme_classic()+
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5, 
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```

### Alluvial

```{r mmus_alluv, fig.height = 9, fig.width = 8}
mat_mmus <- table(
  sce_hsc_all_cells$celltypes[sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID == "mmus"],
  sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label[sce_hsc_all_cells$Species_ID == "mmus"])

mmus_df <- mat_mmus %>%
  base::as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.nan(Freq))

mmus_df$Var2_rev <- mmus_df$Var2
mmus_df$Var2_rev <- factor(
  mmus_df$Var2_rev, 
  levels = rev(levels(mmus_df$Var2)))

mmus_df2 <- mmus_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Var1_u = fct_inorder(paste0("orig ", Var1)),
    Var2_u = fct_inorder(paste0("custom ", Var2_rev))
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(data = mmus_df2,
                aes(axis1 = Var1_u,
                    axis2 = Var2_u, 
                    y = Freq))+
  ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Var1_u))+
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum()+
  ggplot2::geom_text(stat = "stratum",
                     aes(label = after_stat(stratum)))+
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.15, 0.05))+
  theme_void()+
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")+
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = col_cts_hsc_orig)
```

```{r all_alluv, fig.height = 18, fig.width = 8}
mat_all <- table(

  sce_hsc_all_cells$custom_label)

all_df <- mat_all %>%
  base::as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.nan(Freq))

all_df$Var2_rev <- all_df$Var2
all_df$Var2_rev <- factor(
  all_df$Var2_rev, 
  levels = rev(levels(all_df$Var2)))

all_df2 <- all_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Var1_u = fct_inorder(paste0("orig ", Var1)),
    Var2_u = fct_inorder(paste0("custom ", Var2_rev))
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(data = all_df2,
                aes(axis1 = Var1_u,
                    axis2 = Var2_u, 
                    y = Freq))+
  ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Var1_u))+
```
